facts.fact: Filomeno（革命中失去一只耳朵的果农）求 Inés 向姨妈说情宽限借款，怕 Cándido 上门
facts.anchor: I’d hate to have Cándido knocking at my door

facts.fact: Perla 的放贷生意：小镇无银行，她放贷做得不错，收账外包给 Cándido
facts.anchor: Perla had become accustomed to moneylending

facts.fact: Cándido 街头拦截晃钞票逼情报、威胁抽她；Inés 收钱并决意往他汤里吐口水
facts.anchor: She promised herself she’d spit in his soup the next time he was dining at their house.

facts.fact: Inés 与 Ulises 在他房间定计：Lulú 是从不生病的疑病症患者，可以让她「真病」逼 Cándido 陪她就医
facts.anchor: She’s a hypochondriac who worries about the smallest ache

facts.fact: 毒方：Raíz de Xalapa 可做泻药；她不知道如何让 Lulú 服下，他提议下食物
facts.anchor: Raíz de Xalapa is used as a laxative

facts.fact: Perla 拒绝宽限 Filomeno 并骂 Inés「跟你妈一模一样」；Inés 以母亲记忆强化逃离决心
facts.anchor: What a silly girl you are, just like your mother in every way.

facts.fact: 星期日委员会聚会：Ulises 假意关怀 Lulú 健康劝咖啡，Inés 掺足泻药——Lulú 恐慌离席
facts.anchor: the laxative was beginning to take effect

facts.fact: 三天后 Marisol 报信：Lulú 与 Cándido 去墨西哥城就医走三周；Inés 一路笑跑
facts.anchor: I’m wicked and I don’t much care
